name: Cypress Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Cypress Holdings Co., Ltd. operates and manages a food store that offers various Japanese food brands in Japan. The company provides seafood, sushi, yakitori, noodles, fast food, western food, Chinese food, and cafes. It offers its products under the Tsukiji Shokudo Genchan brand name. Cypress Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Minato, Japan.
